title_en: Not just Golok River, many other 'rat holes' - PGA
summary_en: RANTAU PANJANG: The General Operations Group (PGA) is strengthening border security control to curb the entry of illegal immigrants via land and sea routes, particularly along the Malaysia-Thailand border in Kelantan.

title: GOF: Illegal entries not confined to Golok River
summary: RANTAU PANJANG: Undocumented migrants are entering Malaysia through various routes, not just the Golok River, prompting the General Operations Force (GOF) to strengthen security along land and sea borders.

title: Pakistani shop owner arrested over 19-year Thai identity fraud
summary: A Pakistani shop owner was arrested in Pattani over Thai identity fraud dating to 2007, when he allegedly paid 100,000 baht for an ID.
